import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class FlowEdge {
        int v, u;
        long cap, flow = 0;
        FlowEdge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            this.v = v;
            this.u = u;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        final long flow_inf = (long) 1e18;
        ArrayList<FlowEdge> edges;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> adj;
        int n, m = 0;
        int s, t;
        int[] level, ptr;
        Queue<Integer> q;

        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            this.n = n;
            this.s = s;
            this.t = t;
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void add(int v, int u, long cap) {
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, cap));
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, 0));
            adj.get(v).add(m);
            adj.get(u).add(m + 1);
            m += 2;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int viz : adj.get(v)) {
                    FlowEdge e = edges.get(viz);
                    if (e.cap - e.flow < 1) continue;
                    if (level[e.u] != -1) continue;
                    level[e.u] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(e.u);
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int v, long pushed) {
            if (pushed == 0) return 0;
            if (v == t) return pushed;
            for (int i = ptr[v]; i < adj.get(v).size(); i++) {
                int viz = adj.get(v).get(i);
                int u = edges.get(viz).u;
                if (level[v] + 1 != level[u] || edges.get(viz).cap - edges.get(viz).flow < 1) continue;
                long tr = dfs(u, Math.min(pushed, edges.get(viz).cap - edges.get(viz).flow));
                if (tr == 0) continue;
                edges.get(viz).flow += tr;
                edges.get(viz ^ 1).flow -= tr;
                return tr;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long flow() {
            long f = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(level, -1);
                level[s] = 0;
                q.clear();
                q.add(s);
                if (!bfs()) break;
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfs(s, flow_inf)) > 0)
                    f += pushed;
            }
            return f;
        }
    }

    static int[][] pos = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] matTempo = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] matAlc = new int[150][150];

    static void criaMatTempo(int i, int j, char[][] sc, int n, int currT) {
        Queue<int[]> queue = new LinkedList<>();
        queue.add(new int[]{i, j, currT});
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = queue.poll();
            int ci = cur[0], cj = cur[1], ct = cur[2];
            if (ci < 0 || ci >= n || cj < 0 || cj >= n) continue;
            char c = sc[ci][cj];
            if (!Character.isDigit(c) && c != 'Z') continue;
            if (matTempo[ci][cj] != -1 && matTempo[ci][cj] <= ct) continue;
            if (matTempo[ci][cj] == -1)
                matTempo[ci][cj] = ct;
            else
                matTempo[ci][cj] = Math.min(ct, matTempo[ci][cj]);
            queue.add(new int[]{ci + 1, cj, ct + 1});
            queue.add(new int[]{ci - 1, cj, ct + 1});
            queue.add(new int[]{ci, cj + 1, ct + 1});
            queue.add(new int[]{ci, cj - 1, ct + 1});
        }
    }

    static void criaMatAlc(int i, int j, char[][] sc, int n, int currT) {
        Queue<int[]> queue = new LinkedList<>();
        queue.add(new int[]{i, j, currT});
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = queue.poll();
            int ci = cur[0], cj = cur[1], ct = cur[2];
            if (ci < 0 || ci >= n || cj < 0 || cj >= n) continue;
            char c = sc[ci][cj];
            if (!Character.isDigit(c)) continue;
            if (matAlc[ci][cj] != -1 && matAlc[ci][cj] <= ct) continue;
            if (matAlc[ci][cj] == -1)
                matAlc[ci][cj] = ct;
            else
                matAlc[ci][cj] = Math.min(ct, matAlc[ci][cj]);
            queue.add(new int[]{ci + 1, cj, ct + 1});
            queue.add(new int[]{ci - 1, cj, ct + 1});
            queue.add(new int[]{ci, cj + 1, ct + 1});
            queue.add(new int[]{ci, cj - 1, ct + 1});
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        int n2 = n * n;
        int nMax = n2 * 2;
        Dinic grafo = new Dinic(nMax + 2, 0, nMax + 1);
        grafo.edges = new ArrayList<>();

        char[][] scGrid = new char[n][n];
        char[][] capsGrid = new char[n][n];

        // read sc
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            scGrid[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        // read caps
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            capsGrid[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        // compute positions
        int cnt = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                pos[i][j] = cnt++;
            }
        }

        // find Z
        int iZ = -1, jZ = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (scGrid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    iZ = i;
                    jZ = j;
                }
            }
        }

        // initialize matTempo with -1
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(matTempo[i], -1);
        criaMatTempo(iZ, jZ, scGrid, n, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (matTempo[i][j] == -1 && Character.isDigit(scGrid[i][j])) {
                    matTempo[i][j] = t;
                }
            }
        }

        // build edges from source to people
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(scGrid[i][j])) {
                    int lmt = scGrid[i][j] - '0';
                    grafo.add(0, pos[i][j], lmt);
                    // compute matAlc for this person
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) Arrays.fill(matAlc[k], -1);
                    criaMatAlc(i, j, scGrid, n, 0);
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                            if (matAlc[k][l] != -1 && matTempo[k][l] != -1 && matAlc[k][l] <= matTempo[k][l] && matAlc[k][l] <= t) {
                                boolean crt = true;
                                if (matAlc[k][l] == matTempo[k][l]) {
                                    crt = false;
                                    if (k + 1 < n && matAlc[k + 1][l] != -1 && matAlc[k + 1][l] < matTempo[k + 1][l]) crt = true;
                                    if (k - 1 >= 0 && matAlc[k - 1][l] != -1 && matAlc[k - 1][l] < matTempo[k - 1][l]) crt = true;
                                    if (l + 1 < n && matAlc[k][l + 1] != -1 && matAlc[k][l + 1] < matTempo[k][l + 1]) crt = true;
                                    if (l - 1 >= 0 && matAlc[k][l - 1] != -1 && matAlc[k][l - 1] < matTempo[k][l - 1]) crt = true;
                                }
                                if (crt) {
                                    grafo.add(pos[i][j], n2 + pos[k][l], lmt);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // build edges from shelters to sink
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(capsGrid[i][j])) {
                    grafo.add(n2 + pos[i][j], nMax + 1, capsGrid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = grafo.flow();
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
